name: To Gadgetzan You Go!
summary: In Orgrimmar, Zamja sends seasoned Horde cooks south to learn from an eccentric goblin butcher.

sections.title: A Cook Outgrows Orgrimmar
sections.body: In the Drag, Zamja trains cooks and feeds warriors and travelers passing through Durotar. When a cook has learned every recipe and technique she knows, Zamja has taught all she can. She sends her pupil to Tanaris, where only a master of strange and exotic meats can help a talented cook advance.

sections.title: The Butcher in the Desert
sections.body: Gadgetzan is a steam-powered trading hub in Tanaris, run by the Steamwheedle Cartel. Dirge Quikcleave works inside the town tavern. The eccentric goblin butcher has an unusual palate and no squeamishness about food. Across Kalimdor, he is known for making hearty meals from monstrous desert creatures and sometimes scraps of leather, food for hardened adventurers.

faq.answer: Zamja, the troll cooking trainer near the cookfires in Orgrimmar's Drag, sends cooks who have mastered all she knows.

faq.q: Why does Zamja send you away?
faq.answer: Zamja has taught all the recipes and techniques she can. She sends promising cooks to Dirge Quikcleave in Tanaris, an eccentric expert who makes meals from harsh desert ingredients.

Dirge Quikcleave is a goblin butcher and artisan cooking trainer in Gadgetzan's inn. He has a rough temperament, odd ideas about nutrition, and finds protein in old leather boots. He has mastered cooking with exotic wilderness ingredients.

faq.q: Is this quest required to learn Artisan Cooking?
faq.answer: No. Zamja's referral points Horde cooks toward Tanaris. A cook with enough skill can travel straight to Gadgetzan and speak with Dirge Quikcleave.
Gadgetzan is a walled desert trading hub run by the Steamwheedle Cartel in northern Tanaris, far south on Kalimdor below Thousand Needles.

faq.q: Does Zamja actually learn anything when you return?
faq.answer: Zamja cheekily asks you to return and teach her once you become the big cook on the block. She remains an expert trainer in Orgrimmar, tending her cookfires for the next generation of travelers.

angles.text: As a cook, you reach the point where instruction in the capital runs out. Then you must venture into the dangerous wilds to study under an artisan master.
Orgrimmar relies on outside specialists, including neutral goblin chefs, to teach its crafters beyond standard tribal staples.
